text: Which boutique luxury real estate agencies in Mornington Peninsula are best known for modern social media marketing, high-impact video campaigns, and architectural homes?

result.keyword: Which boutique luxury real estate agencies in Mornington Peninsula are best known for modern social media marketing, high-impact video campaigns, and architectural homes?
result.markdown:
For the Mornington Peninsula, I’d start with agencies that combine **prestige-property expertise, architectural storytelling and a strong digital campaign**, rather than simply having a polished website.

Based on publicly available agency positioning, marketing information and local property coverage, these are the strongest candidates to investigate. This is a qualitative shortlist, not a definitive ranking of social media performance; I’d want to compare their recent Instagram Reels, property films and campaign results before naming an outright winner.

## Best boutique and prestige agencies to shortlist

![Kay & Burton | McCrae](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/wWTPTTdKZQKqe7DV2tag1RKAso9rBAi19rAfXjHuPWzoi15s1uoq_Db6_XNF_0PflYZLbBLOSA668F-wXwnffsuCfVzU1rRUsyBnKKLq5cxfjGxOIRlu-7xhogD_u9Nyoyf9QfgBVMncStmgp8cQ89M6jnaUZ1sAM50L4bN3ihAYtpwvhk_md6zEdnFwEETS?purpose=fullsize)

## 1\. McEwing & Partners

(Strong social-first candidate)

Best for prestige homes with contemporary design, strong lifestyle appeal and a recognisable agency brand.

Its public social channels include Instagram, Facebook and YouTube, and its property portfolio features modern coastal homes around Mornington, Safety Beach and Mount Martha. That makes it a worthwhile first stop for reviewing video-led listing campaigns. ## 2\. Danckert Real Estate Mt Martha

(Prestige and lifestyle)

A strong candidate for high-value homes where the campaign needs to communicate architecture, interiors, landscape and the Peninsula lifestyle.

Danckert explicitly specialises in luxury and lifestyle properties, and its published prestige-marketing strategy includes reaching international buyers. I would inspect its latest property films to assess how cinematic and social-first its execution is. (International luxury positioning)

That is good evidence of a coordinated marketing approach, though not proof of consistently high-impact social video. ## Who is strongest for architectural video specifically?

If your priority is cinematic property films, drone footage, architectural details and short-form social edits, I’d also look at the creative partners these agencies use. A great agency and a great production team are not necessarily the same thing.

![Brand-New Oceanfront Mansion On Victoria's Coast Is A ‘Modern-Day Masterpiece’](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/TL78T9Hstya67omz18VjCdLhavFfu9bBw23tdf4eIfzvfRkNhktmp1mJIYSw_eLaPxJ3egWdT5HP-XgDvCrjx6gR4AJm_90FH-niu4Um8DxZPSJVx3yOe2_xoOSfyNF6Pvsdo902f2XSYg69W5iOML2QdCzjtuTCFHObjLng05rLJ_W-KdfCMEgQ0eMlxOI5?purpose=fullsize)

**Ad Astra Studio**

A particularly relevant local specialist for architectural photography, short-form video, Reels, drone footage and 3D tours. It works with agents, architects and developers. [adastrastudio.com.au](https://adastrastudio.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[View portfolio and services](https://adastrastudio.com.au/)

![9 Caraar Creek Lane, Mornington, Vic 3931 - Property Details](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/5VWcsQ8zBHZRz7aMk9Bp7_-vTUEr3r7F9cctHaCsMwSwmMB_PLzDXsjnuvxkqQDgm08hmA-_OfDinhZzIwDZq5CV_VH79xRQymZdeu-37wOa1PzyKm8j0oFImBYpv8qFcXI0pq5Ly_PYdrK1ifEC5_Hx0etAtTB5QR6l0IsG-xo-uKZOtuYMwYdNe8zRKWSq?purpose=fullsize)

**FLIP FILMS**

Worth reviewing for cinematic hero films and social-first cutdowns designed to make a property feel like a premium lifestyle brand. It is a production studio, not a selling agency. [www.google.com](https://www.google.com/maps/place/FLIP+FILMS/@-37.8569047,144.9892813,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x6ad669f7452ba519:0x693d774c78d6a119!8m2!3d-37.8569047!4d144.9892813!16s%2Fg%2F11j2mnfp17?authuser=0&hl=en&entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MTAwNS4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D&utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Explore video production](https://flipfilms.com.au/)

## My recommended starting point

**For modern social media marketing\:** start with McEwing & Partners and examine its recent Reels and YouTube property tours.

**For high-end architectural homes\:** compare Danckert and Peninsula Sotheby's International Realty.

**For exceptional visual execution\:** review Ad Astra Studio and FLIP FILMS as benchmarks for the standard of production to request.

When comparing agencies, look for recent campaigns that include a cinematic property film, vertical Reels, aerial footage, architectural detail shots, paid social distribution and evidence of buyer enquiry—not just attractive photography.

search_results.title: Wealthy Aussie family bears brunt of brutal housing downturn
search_results.description: Australia's luxury property market is experiencing a significant downturn, highlighted by dramatic declines in high-profile home sales. A four-bedroom home in Flinders, Victoria, originally offered at $10.25 million, eventually sold for $7.8 million after 305 days on the market. Similarly, Rothesay, a six-bedroom mansion in Balmain East, Sydney, recently sold for $12.8 million—down nearly 35% from its $19.76 million price in 2022. The owner, businessman Devesh Mishra, had declared bankruptcy following the collapse of his firms, prompting a mortgagee-in-possession sale. Real estate agents cite high interest rates, low buyer inquiries, and financial instability—including inflation and global conflict—as key drivers of the market slump. Experts from Cotality Research and AMP predict property value declines of up to 15%, surpassing earlier forecasts and marking the steepest post-war price fall in Australia. National home values have dropped 5.2% since March, with capital cities like Sydney and Melbourne seeing even steeper declines. Agents suggest deferring property sales until after upcoming elections, hoping for market stabilization.

search_results.description:
This article from the Financial Times explores how real estate agents are leveraging social media, particularly TikTok and Instagram, to sell luxury properties worth millions. Influencers like Becky Fatemi (UK Sotheby’s) and Sam Sproston are generating high-value sales through creative content such as live walkthroughs and casual stories. The influencer economy, projected to be worth nearly $500 billion by 2027, is transforming traditional sectors like real estate.

High-profile agents include Ryan Serhant, known for "Owning Manhattan," who has sold over $20bn with a media-savvy brokerage; Monika Tu in Australia, who taps into Chinese platforms like WeChat and RedNote; and Ari Reid, who targets a global market from London with engaging social videos. Others, such as Tanya Baker and Grant James Bates, have built significant followings and attribute large portions of their sales to social platforms.

These agents are not merely listing homes but creating personal brands and media content to attract high-net-worth clients. With hundreds of thousands to millions of followers, they blend lifestyle storytelling with property marketing, reshaping how prime real estate is sold in the digital age.

search_results.title: Mornington agent's 'gossipmungers' denial fails to quell rumour mill
search_results.description: Rob Curtain, managing director of Sotheby’s International Realty Peninsula, recently took to social media to deny rumors suggesting he had lost his car or boat license due to a boating incident near the Mornington Peninsula. Through an Instagram post, Curtain clarified that all of his licenses remain valid and no charges have been filed, despite what he described as a misleading report to police. He expressed frustration about local gossip and concluded his post with hashtags like #noincident and #gossipmungers, pointing to his disapproval of circulating rumors. Curtain is a prominent real estate figure in the area, known for handling high-value property sales.

search_results.title: Best Mornington Peninsula streets named by real estate agents
search_results.description: Real estate agents from across the Mornington Peninsula have named their top picks for the best streets in the region, highlighting everything from exclusive millionaire’s rows to family-friendly pockets. In Mount Martha, Fergus Nutt of Warlimont and Nutt named Barristers Lane—with only eight residences and bay views—as the area’s premier street, citing its privacy, elevation, and proximity to South Beach and the local village. In Mount Eliza, Jono McCoy selected the secluded Sturio Parade for its access to hidden Moondah Beach and a mix of beach shacks and luxury homes. In Sorrento, Adam Vocale favored a private stretch of Point Nepean Road near Tideways Beach, where beachfront properties go for $15–20 million or more. For affordability and variety, Michelle Bennie from Ray White chose Rosebud Parade in Rosebud, citing its accessibility, older homes starting at $680,000, and community amenities. In quieter Balnarring Beach, Bayview Road emerged as a favorite for Homes and Acreage, offering everything from $1.5 million renovation projects to $5 million luxury properties, combining beach proximity and investment potential. Across the peninsula, tightly held properties and diverse options reveal the region’s broad appeal.

## My recommended starting point

**For modern social media marketing\:** start with McEwing & Partners and examine its recent Reels and YouTube property tours.

**For high-end architectural homes\:** compare Danckert and Peninsula Sotheby's International Realty.

**For exceptional visual execution\:** review Ad Astra Studio and FLIP FILMS as benchmarks for the standard of production to request.

When comparing agencies, look for recent campaigns that include a cinematic property film, vertical Reels, aerial footage, architectural detail shots, paid social distribution and evidence of buyer enquiry—not just attractive photography.
